title: Updating an execution record coordinate
statement: Given an execution record $e$, a coordinate index $r\in\{0,1,\ldots,10\}$, and a natural number $v$, define the updated record by replacing coordinate $r$ with $v$ and leaving every other coordinate unchanged. The coordinates are ordered as the number of circuit inputs, number of hard-wired input bits, step budget, current instruction, preceding cell of that instruction, first instruction of the current step, step-loop counter, inner-loop counter, position in the hard-wired input, position in the free input, and scratch value.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ is a coordinate index from $0$ through $10$
